overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、行为金融（2 篇）、资产定价（2 篇）。方法上以回归分析、数值模拟为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（4 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Correcting collection bias in comparative studies of diversity
papers.venue: Journal of The Royal Society Interface
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Comparative analyses of diversity in human populations often rely on historical, archival and observational data, which are systematically shaped by uneven documentation, preservation and research attention. Such collection bias can distort comparisons across populations, regions or time periods, obscuring genuine patterns of variation or generating spurious ones. Standard approaches that equalize sample size or sampling effort implicitly assume comparable sampling completeness, which is an assumption rarely satisfied in human and historical datasets. Here, we evaluate coverage-based standardization, adapted from ecological diversity estimation, as a general framework for comparative diversity analysis under biased and incomplete observation. Using population-level simulations, we show that coverage-based approaches reliably recover true diversity relationships across multiple, qualitatively distinct mechanisms of collection bias, whereas sample-size-based methods yield systematically distorted inferences. We illustrate the utility of this framework with an application to a large historical cultural dataset, where correcting for uneven documentation substantially refines inferred diversity patterns. By conditioning comparisons on sampling completeness rather than raw sample size, coverage-based standardization offers a principled and broadly applicable solution for comparative research in any domain where observation is biased, incomplete or historically contingent.
papers.summary_zh:
【行为金融】摘要  
对人类群体多样性的比较分析通常依赖于历史数据、档案资料和观察数据，但这些数据在记录、保存和研究关注度方面存在系统性差异。这种数据收集偏差可能会扭曲不同群体、地区或时间段的比较结果，掩盖真实的变异模式或产生虚假的变异模式。传统的标准化方法（如通过调整样本量或采样工作量来平衡数据）隐含着“采样完整性相同”的假设，然而这一假设在人类学和历史数据集中很少得到满足。本文提出了一种基于覆盖率的标准化方法，该方法借鉴了生态多样性评估的原理，适用于在存在数据收集偏差和数据不完整情况下的多样性比较分析。通过群体层面的模拟实验，我们发现基于覆盖率的标准化方法能够可靠地揭示多种不同类型数据收集偏差下的真实多样性关系，而基于样本量的方法则会导致系统性的偏差。我们以一个大型历史文化数据集为例，说明该方法的实用性：通过纠正数据记录的不均衡问题，可以显著改善多样性分析的结果。通过将比较结果建立在采样完整性的基础上，而非单纯的样本量基础上，基于覆盖率的标准化方法为任何观察数据存在偏差、不完整或受历史因素影响的领域提供了原则性且具有广泛适用性的解决方案。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Revealed Attentional Interference
papers.abstract: We study the impact of external stimuli on attention in the Attentional Interference Model, capturing two opposing forces in consideration-set formation: proactive and retroactive interference. Proactive interference limits the permeation of external information, while retroactive interference displaces internally generated considerations. We model these forces using parameters governing permeation and displacement. In a general setting, we characterize the tight range of these parameters and show that, across several specifications, only an upper bound on permeation is revealed. Imposing monotonicity on internal attention in one case both tightens this upper bound and yields a lower bound. We illustrate our results through simulation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们在“注意力干扰模型”（Attentional Interference Model）中研究了外部刺激对注意力的影响，该模型考虑了在思维集合形成过程中存在的两种对立力量：前摄性干扰（proactive interference）和后摄性干扰（retroactive interference）。前摄性干扰限制了外部信息的渗透，而后摄性干扰则取代了内部产生的思维内容。我们通过控制信息渗透和思维内容替换的参数来模拟这两种力量。在一般性情境下，我们描述了这些参数的取值范围，并发现：在多种设定条件下，仅能确定渗透性的上限。在某些情况下，通过对内部注意力施加单调性约束，不仅能够进一步缩小这一上限，还能得到一个下限。我们通过仿真实验来验证我们的研究结果。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Measuring Sentiment News with Transformer-Based Language Models
papers.abstract: Measuring sentiment from financial news is a central task in economics and finance, yet most existing indicators rely on dictionary-based approaches that infer sentiment from word counts and only partially capture context, negation, and semantic structure. This paper proposes a framework for constructing daily news mood indices using transformer-based language models and evaluates whether they better represent sentiment than dictionary-based alternatives. Using 143,755 financial news articles from Factiva, we classify sentiment at the sentence level with FinBERT and aggregate these predictions into article-level and daily sentiment measures through alternative normalization schemes. We compare the resulting indices with benchmark measures based on Shapiro et al., 2022 and Barbaglia et al., 2025. A central contribution is the validation of alternative sentiment measures against human judgments. We conducted an incentivized annotation exercise in which 444 participants evaluated a validation subsample of 588 financial news articles. Consensus ratings from independent human evaluations serve as an external benchmark for assessing the quality of automated sentiment measures. Across correlation, regression, and classification exercises, transformer-based measures show stronger agreement with human judgments than vocabulary-based alternatives and perform substantially better in distinguishing positive, neutral, and negative articles. Overall, the results suggest that incorporating contextual information through transformer-based language models produces sentiment measures that more closely reflect human assessments of financial news.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】从财经新闻中提取情感信息是经济学和金融学领域的一项核心任务。然而，现有的大多数情感分析指标都依赖于基于词典的方法，这些方法通过统计词汇出现的频率来推断情感，但仅能部分地捕捉到文本的上下文、否定词以及语义结构。本文提出了一种利用基于Transformer的语言模型构建每日新闻情绪指数的框架，并评估了这些模型在表达情感方面是否优于基于词典的模型。我们使用了Factiva数据库中的143,755篇财经新闻文章，利用FinBERT在句子层面对情感进行分类，并通过不同的归一化方法将这些分类结果汇总为文章层面和每日的情感度量指标。我们将这些指数与Shapiro（2022年）和Barbaglia（2025年）提出的基准指标进行了比较。本文的一个重要贡献是对这些情感度量指标进行了基于人类判断的验证：我们组织了一次有激励机制的注释活动，共有444名参与者对588篇财经新闻文章进行了评估。独立的人类评估结果为评估自动化情感度量的质量提供了外部基准。在相关性分析、回归分析和分类实验中，基于Transformer的模型与人类判断的一致性更高，并且在区分正面、中性和负面新闻方面表现更为出色。总体而言，研究...。研究方法：回归分析、Transformer 模型。

papers.title: A characterization of subgame perfect equilibria in single-leader multi-follower games
papers.abstract: Single-leader multi-follower games model the sequential strategic interactions between one player who chooses first, the leader, and other players, the followers, who respond simultaneously after observing the choice of the leader. In this paper we focus on the concept of subgame perfect equilibrium (SPE for short) in single-leader multi-follower games when the followers are involved in a generalized game and have a non-unique joint best response for each choice of the leader. We first show the connections between the concept of an SPE and those of a pessimistic and optimistic equilibrium, which are usually adopted and extensively studied in this framework. We then prove an existence result for SPEs and a characterization of the set of SPE-outcomes. Specifically, an action profile is shown to be an SPE-outcome if and only if the joint response of the followers to the leader is rational and the leader’s payoff lies between the payoffs achievable in a pessimistic equilibrium and in an optimistic equilibrium. Finally, moving to the broader framework of multi-leader-follower games, we show the existence of SPEs and we identify a subset of SPE-outcomes for a class of multi-leader-follower games where the game played by the leaders involves a generalized weighted potential structure.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】单领导者多追随者博弈模型描述了这样一个顺序策略互动过程：首先由领导者做出选择，随后其他追随者在观察到领导者的决策后同时作出反应。在本文中，我们重点探讨了当追随者参与一种广义博弈，并且对于领导者的每一个选择都存在非唯一的联合最优响应时，单领导者多追随者博弈中的子博弈完美均衡（简称SPE）概念。我们首先阐明了SPE概念与通常在该框架内被采用并广泛研究的悲观均衡与乐观均衡之间的联系。接着，我们证明了SPE的存在性，并对SPE结果集进行了特征描述。具体而言，一个行动组合被视为SPE结果当且仅当追随者对领导者的联合响应是理性的，并且领导者的收益介于悲观均衡与乐观均衡所能实现的收益之间。最后，我们将研究范围扩展到多领导者多追随者博弈的更一般情形，证明了SPE的存在性，并确定了一类多领导者多追随者博弈中SPE结果的子集——这些博弈中领导者的策略选择涉及一种广义的加权潜在结构。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: DEVELOPMENT OF A MODEL FOR EVALUATING THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS IN COMMERCIAL BANKS
papers.abstract: This article examines the evolving role of the board of directors in modern commercial banks, which has expanded beyond the general oversight of management. Due to the opaqueness of the banking sector, evaluating the board's performance directly impacts financial stability and the quality of corporate governance. The study proposes a composite model that combines theoretical foundations with international principles, providing a multi­dimen­sional analysis of the board's activities across structural, operational, and strategic dimensions. This model allows for the calculation of a Board Effectiveness Index to identify specific areas requiring improvement within banks.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文探讨了现代商业银行董事会角色的演变，其职责已超越了对管理层的一般监督范围。由于银行业务的复杂性，直接评估董事会的绩效对金融稳定性和公司治理质量具有重要影响。研究提出了一种综合模型，该模型将理论基础与国际准则相结合，从结构、运营和战略三个维度对董事会的各项工作进行了多维度分析。该模型能够计算出“董事会效能指数”，从而识别出银行内部需要改进的具体领域。。

papers.title: VAIOM: Continuous-Input, Discrete-Output Decoder-Only Financial Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract: Financial observations are continuous, heterogeneous, and noisy, whereas decoder-only next-token models are usually built around discrete symbolic inputs. We introduce Vector-Input Autoregressive Inference for Ordinal-Return Modeling (VAIOM), a decoder-only Transformer for probabilistic next-return modeling on one-hour foreign-exchange bars. VAIOM separates input representation from output likelihood: continuous multivariate financial-event vectors preserve numerical structure at the input, while a categorical distribution over the next volatility-normalized return bucket supports cross-entropy training and likelihood evaluation. The selected 0.9M Hybrid Continuous Input model combines continuous event features with categorical asset metadata, a Mixture-of-Market-States return head, Gap, volatility-regime, and Ordinal auxiliary objectives, and full-sequence supervision. Models and preprocessing are fit using pre-2024 Train data; models are selected on 2024H2 Validation and evaluated without refitting on two 2025 Test periods. Across three independent training seeds, every model outperforms fixed single-bar LightGBM baseline in both Test halves. For the canonical checkpoint, paired gains over LightGBM are 0.029 and 0.043 bits per event. Validation experiments show that continuous input improves over discrete-token input under the same categorical return objective, full-sequence supervision improves over last-position training, and auxiliary representation shaping together with a mixture-structured return head improves return likelihood in controlled comparisons. A supporting capacity study finds that the smallest evaluated complete architecture rung achieves the strongest Validation likelihood on the present corpus.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融观测数据具有连续性、异质性和噪声特性，而仅依赖解码器的下一符号模型通常是基于离散的符号输入构建的。我们提出了“向量输入自回归推断用于序数回报建模”（Vector-Input Autoregressive Inference for Ordinal-Return Modeling，简称VAIOM）方法，这是一种专门用于一小时外汇数据概率性下一回报建模的仅解码器型Transformer模型。VAIOM将输入表示与输出概率分离：连续的多变量金融事件向量在输入层保留了数值结构，而针对下一波动率标准化回报值的分类分布则支持交叉熵训练和概率评估。所采用的0.9M混合连续输入模型结合了连续事件特征与分类资产元数据、市场状态混合模型（Mixture-of-Market-States）回报机制、波动率区间识别以及序数辅助目标，并采用了全序列监督训练方法。模型和预处理过程均使用2024年之前的训练数据完成；模型在2024年下半年的验证数据集上进行筛选，并在两个2025年的测试数据集上进行评估（无需重新训练）。在三种不同的训练设置下，所有模型的表现均优于固定的单条数据LightGBM基线模型。在标...。研究方法：Transformer 模型、实验方法。

papers.title: Detecting unusual trading patterns on cryptocurrency exchanges by means of complexity measures
papers.abstract: Artificial transaction generation remains an important source of potential market manipulation on cryptocurrency exchanges, as it may distort reported liquidity and reduce market transparency. This study proposes a diagnostic framework for detecting unusual trading patterns based on complexity and statistical-structure measures derived from high-frequency trade-level data. The analysis considers log-returns, trading volume, and transaction counts, using tail distributions, autocorrelation functions, multifractal characteristics, approximate entropy, and detrended cross-correlations. The methodology is applied to BTC, ETH, and XRP traded on Binance, Bitget, KuCoin, and Kraken over the period from April 1 to June 30, 2025. The results reveal a pronounced anomaly on Bitget for BTC and ETH after mid-May 2025. The number of transactions increases sharply, but there is no proportional increase in traded volume or return fluctuations. This regime is characterised by numerous low-volume trades, weaker autocorrelations, reduced multifractal organisation, higher short-pattern irregularity, and weaker cross-correlations involving the transaction-count series. These features are consistent with a noise-like component in trading activity and may indicate artificially increased transaction counts, although they do not provide direct proof of wash trading. The findings show that complexity-based indicators can be useful for detecting exchange-specific trading anomalies that remain hidden in price-based measures.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】人工交易生成仍然是加密货币交易所潜在市场操纵的重要来源，因为它可能扭曲报告的流动性并降低市场透明度。本研究提出了一种诊断框架，用于基于高频交易数据中的复杂性和统计结构指标来检测异常交易模式。分析考虑了对数收益率、交易量和交易笔数，并使用了尾部分布、自相关函数、多重分形特征、近似熵以及去趋势后的交叉相关性等指标。该方法应用于2025年4月1日至6月30日期间在Binance、Bitget、KuCoin和Kraken平台上交易的BTC、ETH和XRP。研究结果表明，在2025年5月中旬之后，Bitget平台上的BTC和ETH交易出现了明显异常：交易笔数急剧增加，但交易量和收益率波动并未相应增加。这种交易模式的特点是存在大量低成交量交易、自相关性减弱、多重分形结构紊乱、短期交易不规则性增强，以及交易笔数序列的交叉相关性降低。这些特征与交易活动中的“噪声”成分相符，可能表明交易笔数被人为增加，尽管它们并不能直接证明存在洗售行为。研究结果表明，基于复杂性的指标有助于检测那些在基于价格的指标中难以发现的、特定于交易所的交易异常现象。。

papers.title: Global factors for local shocks in a data-scarce environment: with an application to regional fiscal multipliers in Italy
papers.abstract: We propose a novel econometric methodology for Structural Vector Autoregressions with external instruments (`proxy-SVARs' or `SVAR-IVs') in panel data characterized by strong cross-sectional dependence, dynamic heterogeneity, and limited availability of direct external instruments for the shocks of interest. For each unit, we specify a Factor-Augmented proxy-SVAR (`proxy-FA-SVAR') that incorporates factors summarizing cross-sectional information from the non-policy variables of the system. The effects of the policy shocks are then recovered indirectly by estimating unit-specific policy reaction functions through a Minimum Distance approach. Identification relies on global instruments for the non-policy shocks; that is, proxies common to all units in the panel, internally constructed from a separate SVAR estimated on factors for the policy and non-policy variables. These global instruments can be complemented with local (idiosyncratic) instruments constructed from auxiliary unit-level SVARs. Their joint use renders the proxy-FA-SVARs overidentified and therefore statistically testable. We illustrate the methodology by estimating government spending multipliers for Italian NUTS-2 regions using annual data. The global and local instruments for the regional output shocks are obtained from Blanchard-Perotti-type SVARs.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我们提出了一种新的计量经济学方法，用于处理具有强横截面依赖性、动态异质性以及感兴趣的冲击变量直接外部工具有限特征的面板数据中的结构向量自回归模型（即“代理SVARs”或“SVAR-IVs”）。对于每个观测单元，我们构建了一个包含系统非政策变量横截面信息因子的因子增强型代理SVAR（proxy-FA-SVAR）。然后通过最小距离法估计单元特定的政策反应函数来间接推断政策冲击的影响。模型的识别依赖于全局工具，这些工具用于衡量非政策冲击，即对所有观测单元都适用的代理变量；这些代理变量是通过分别对政策变量和非政策变量构建的SVAR模型内部推导出来的。这些全局工具可以结合从辅助的单元级SVAR模型中得到的局部（特定于单元的）工具来使用。这种联合使用方式使得proxy-FA-SVAR模型具有过度识别的特性，从而具备统计检验的可行性。我们利用年度数据，以意大利NUTS-2地区的政府支出乘数为例，展示了该方法的适用性。用于衡量区域产出冲击的全局和局部工具均来源于Blanchard-Perotti类型的SVAR模型。。研究方法：面板数据、向量自回归、横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: Estimation and Inference for Latent Dual Networks Using High-Dimensional IV Screening
papers.abstract: We develop a novel methodology for estimation and inference in high-dimensional panel network models with latent dual structures. The framework allows outcomes to be affected simultaneously by positive and negative interaction channels, accommodating settings in which some interactions reinforce outcomes while others generate competition and displacement effects. The proposed method identifies and estimates the network directly from the structural model using observed data without the need to pre-specify the network. Network recovery is achieved through a sequential instrumental-variable screening procedure. We establish exact support recovery and oracle-equivalent post-selection inference. An application to U.S. corporate leverage data reveals the coexistence of reinforcing and displacement interactions in firms' financial decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种新的方法论，用于具有潜在双重结构的高维面板网络模型的估计与推断。该框架允许结果同时受到正向和负向交互渠道的影响，适用于某些交互作用增强结果而另一些交互作用产生竞争和替代效应的情形。所提出的方法直接从结构模型中利用观测数据识别和估计网络，无需预先指定网络结构。通过网络顺序工具变量筛选程序实现网络结构的恢复。我们证明了精确的支持度恢复能力以及与完美信息下相同的后选择推断性能。通过对美国企业杠杆率数据的应用分析，发现企业在财务决策中同时存在增强效应和替代效应。。研究方法：结构模型。

papers.title: Messy Research, Certification and the Monetization of Science
papers.abstract: I study how cheaper AI-assisted research changes the institutions that certify science. AI lowers the cost of producing a polished manuscript faster than it lowers the cost of judging whether the underlying contribution is valuable. Polish therefore loses information, entry expands and the average quality of the uncertified pool can fall. At a fixed standard, the willingness to pay for credible certification then rises because the outside option deteriorates. A certifier with market power can capture this premium; competition and alternative disclosure rules need not produce the same fee. With fixed review capacity and weak commitment, certification instead dilutes. In that extension, the partial Pigouvian toll on submissions and the shadow value of review capacity both rise with AI-assisted entry. The contribution is to connect the economics of AI and scientific production to signaling, certification and peer review: cheaper production shifts scarcity downstream, from making research look credible to verifying which research is credible.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我研究了人工智能辅助研究如何改变那些负责认证科学成果的机构。人工智能降低了撰写高质量学术论文的成本，但其降低论文价值评估成本的速度却相对较慢。因此，论文在经过修改后可能会丢失部分信息，导致未经认证的论文数量增加，整个论文群体的平均质量下降。在标准不变的情况下，由于外部认证服务的质量下降，人们愿意为可信的认证支付更多费用。拥有市场力量的认证机构可以获取这部分额外收益；而竞争机制或替代性的信息披露规则可能无法带来同样的效果。当评审资源固定且评审人员的积极性较低时，认证过程反而会削弱论文的质量。此外，随着人工智能辅助研究的增加，提交论文所需承担的部分“庇古税”（即因认证带来的额外成本）以及评审资源的“影子价值”（即其潜在的社会价值）也会上升。本文的贡献在于将人工智能与科学研究的经济学原理与信号传递、认证机制及同行评审过程联系起来：人工智能降低了论文制作的成本，但这种成本降低的影响更多地体现在将稀缺性从“让研究看起来可信”这一阶段，转移到了“验证哪些研究真正可信”这一阶段。。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Impact of Green Bonds on Environmental Quality: A Cross‐Country Analysis of the Load Capacity Factor
papers.abstract:
This study investigates the impact of green bonds on environmental sustainability for a panel of 15 countries from 2014 to 2024, using the load capacity factor (LCF) as the main proxy for environmental quality, with biocapacity, ecological footprint, and CO
 2
 emissions per capita used as additional environmental indicators. Empirically, we employ a panel data framework combining fixed effects estimation with instrumental variable generalized method of moments (IV‐GMM), using lagged values of the endogenous regressors and an external shift‐share instrument based on global green bond issuance to address potential endogeneity and reverse causality concerns. To account for cross‐sectional dependence, standard errors are corrected using Driscoll–Kraay estimators. In addition, we apply panel quantile regression techniques at the 10th, 50th, and 90th percentiles to examine heterogeneous effects across the distribution of environmental performance. The results show that higher green bond issuance significantly improves LCF and biocapacity, while reducing the ecological footprint and CO
 2
 emissions. These effects are robust across model specifications and are stronger in countries with higher levels of environmental performance and greater environmental pressures. The findings highlight the central role of green finance in supporting the transition to more sustainable development.

papers.title: THRESHOLD ANALYSIS OF ARMENIA'S PUBLIC DEBT AND ECONOMIC GROWTH
papers.abstract: This analysis examines the relationship between public debt and economic growth in Armenia over the period 2000-2025. The period under consideration covers the entire historical range of Armenia’s debt, from 14.6% of GDP (2008) to 67.4% (2020). The study estimates linear and quadratic OLS specifications and conducts a grid-search threshold test to determine whether there is a structural break in the growth-debt relationship at any level of the observed debt range. The dynamics of Armenia’s economic growth are largely caused by external capital inflows, particularly remittances and migration, rather than by the domestic debt position. The results of this study extend a series of studies on the dynamics and sustainability of Armenia’s public debt.
